harness.name: ChatGPT Work native market-validation workflow
harness.inspiration: DeepSeek Harness goal/round/handoff/stop-gate patterns; adapted to Work tools and repository state, not a literal DSH runtime
harness.execution_trigger: Start a ChatGPT Work task pointing to WORK_START.md
harness.autonomous_scope: within a user-started Work task, bounded by evidence gate, rounds, and user confirmations

guardrails.desk_pass_definition: 16 distinct P×S cells × 3 phases: discover, falsify, revise (not 48 new primary datasets)

household_profiles.name: 任せ方に迷う親
household_profiles.definition: 小5〜6。親は裁量を渡したいが具体的な対象・条件・金額に迷う。親自身の未解決課題を確認する。

household_profiles.name: 相談摩擦のある親子
household_profiles.definition: R/O/F/Bは面談後に判定。直近1〜3か月の買い物/お小遣い相談、本人の遠慮、親の改善意欲を別々に確認する。

household_profiles.name: 体験の準備負担がある親
household_profiles.definition: 家の仕事・買い物・料理を子に任せたいが、親の時間/準備が制約。実際の代替手段を確認する。

household_profiles.name: 別居祖父母参加可能な家庭
household_profiles.definition: 親の利用意向と本人の共有意向を前提に、祖父母が受動閲覧と能動近況投稿で価値を得るかを検証。祖父母課金は別仮説。

segment_model.P1_P2_P3: overlapping jobs to be done; do not sum as separate market sizes
segment_model.P4: grandparent participation / gift-payer modifier, not an independent mutually exclusive segment
segment_model.cross_product: analysis grid only, not a 16-market TAM model

first_run_rule: Complete source audit and decision outputs once even if new externally verifiable data are unavailable; subsequent iterations need new evidence or observed user data.

status_meanings.RESEARCHED: Desk research outputs validated; no real sales claims
status_meanings.NEEDS_REAL_CUSTOMERS: Desk outputs finished, key business claim still needs observed user/payment behavior
status_meanings.BLOCKED: Research access/evidence cannot resolve core uncertainty
status_meanings.COMPLETE: Only when observed customer/action evidence justifies claimed business result
